name: ODRL Offer
abstract: W3C ODRL 2.2 Offer policy stating the access and usage conditions a data provider sets for a digital object: permissions (may do), obligations (must do) and prohibitions (must not do), each with an action, a target asset and optional constraints. A permission duty constrained by odrl:event odrl:lt odrl:policyUsage marks an access condition, to be fulfilled before the object is retrieved. Keys carry the odrl: prefix, with the odrl, cdifa1 and rdf prefixes declared in the @context; IRI values are {@id} objects. Draft: the cdifa1 action vocabulary and the ODRL profile it lives in are not yet defined. Built on the generic ODRL blocks; this block adds only CDIF Access rules (fixed odrl:profile, policy-level assigner, targets on permissions and prohibitions, the access-condition marker). Uses building blocks: odrlPolicy (odrlProperties).
description:
## ODRL Offer

A [W3C ODRL 2.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/odrl-model/) Offer: the access and usage conditions a data provider sets for a digital object. Draft for the CDIF Access profile ([cdifAccess](../../profiles/cdifProfile/cdifAccess/)).

- **odrl:permission**: what a user may do (e.g. `cdifa1:download`), optionally scoped by constraints (e.g. users located in the UK).
- **odrl:duty** on a permission, constrained by `odrl:event odrl:lt odrl:policyUsage`: an **access condition**, done before retrieval (e.g. assent to a licence).
- **odrl:obligation**: what every user must do (e.g. destroy the data by a date).
- **odrl:prohibition**: what a user must not do (e.g. share TRE credentials).
- **odrl:assigner** / **odrl:assignee**: the parties. `odrl:assigner` is the provider (a reference or an `odrl:Party`); `odrl:assignee` on a rule is a reference, an `odrl:Party`, or an `odrl:PartyCollection`. A collection can be narrowed with `odrl:source` (the collection) plus `odrl:refinement` (e.g. registered users located in the UK).

Keys carry the `odrl:` prefix, and the `@context` declares the `odrl`, `cdifa1` and `rdf` prefixes. The ODRL JSON-LD context is not used, so IRI values (targets, actions, parties, operands) are written as `{"@id": ...}` objects.

### Open questions

- The `cdifa1` action vocabulary and the ODRL profile at `https://w3id.org/cdif/access/profile1/` do not exist yet.
- Constraint operand values and the constraint `@type` are unspecified by the spreadsheet. (LogicalConstraint and AssetCollection are available through the generic blocks.)
- Scoping users by constraint (the spreadsheet) or by assignee PartyCollection with refinement (the book); both are allowed. No shared vocabulary of PartyCollection IRIs exists yet.
- What an assent duty assents to.

### Dependencies

- [odrlPolicy](../odrlPolicy/) - the generic ODRL policy, which brings in odrlRule, odrlAction, odrlConstraint, odrlParty, odrlAsset and odrlTerms

examples.title: Example ODRL Offer
examples.content:
Offer for one distribution: users located in the UK may download it
after assenting to the licence (an access condition), must destroy the
data by a fixed date (an obligation with a refined action), and must not
share TRE credentials (a prohibition). A second permission grants
odrl:use to an odrl:PartyCollection: the repository's registered users,
refined to those located in the UK. Illustrative values only.

annotatedSchema:
$schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
title: ODRL Offer
description: 'CDIF Access profile of an ODRL 2.2 Offer (https://www.w3.org/TR/odrl-model/#policy-offer):
  the baseline access and usage conditions a data provider sets for a digital object,
  without naming who they apply to (that is an ODRL Agreement). Built on the generic
  odrlPolicy block, which carries the ODRL structure; this block adds only CDIF''s
  own rules. Draft from the CDIF Access spreadsheet (CDIF_Access_Profile_ODRL_Classes_Properties_Description.xlsx)
  and the cdifbook data_access chapter.

  Keys carry the odrl: prefix and the document''s @context declares the odrl, cdifa1
  (https://w3id.org/cdif/access/profile1/), rdf and xsd prefixes. The ODRL JSON-LD
  context is not used, so nothing coerces a string to an IRI: every IRI value (target,
  action, parties, operands) is an {"@id": ...} object.

  An access condition (something done BEFORE the digital object is retrieved) is a
  permission duty constrained by odrl:event odrl:lt odrl:policyUsage (https://www.w3.org/TR/odrl-model/#duty-perm).
  Everything else is a usage condition: a permission (may do), an obligation (must
  do) or a prohibition (must not do).

  OPEN QUESTIONS are marked "OPEN:" below.'
type: object
allOf:
- $ref: https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/metadataBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/bbr/metadata/odrlProperties/odrlPolicy/schema.yaml
properties:
  '@context':
    type: object
    description: 'JSON-LD namespace prefixes for ODRL policy properties. Not required:
      an Offer embedded in a CDIF record inherits the record''s @context.'
    properties:
      odrl:
        const: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/
      cdifa1:
        const: https://w3id.org/cdif/access/profile1/
      rdf:
        const: http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#
      xsd:
        const: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#
  '@type':
    description: Always includes odrl:Offer.
    contains:
      const: odrl:Offer
  '@id':
    description: Globally unique, resolvable IRI for this Offer (the spreadsheet's
      uid). A resolver should be able to return application/ld+json, not only an HTML
      page.
  odrl:profile:
    description: 'The CDIF Access ODRL profile this policy uses, which supplies the
      cdifa1: actions the ODRL core vocabulary lacks (download, assent, datadestruction,
      ...). OPEN: nothing is published at this IRI yet, and it names a .ttl file where
      ODRL expects a profile identifier. The cdifa1: form is accepted because compaction
      under the cdifa1 prefix rewrites the full IRI to it.'
    type: object
    properties:
      '@id':
        enum:
        - https://w3id.org/cdif/access/profile1/cdifa1.ttl
        - cdifa1:cdifa1.ttl
    required:
    - '@id'
    x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/profile
  odrl:target:
    description: Asset all rules apply to, if given once at policy level (range odrl:Asset).
    $ref: https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/metadataBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/bbr/metadata/odrlProperties/odrlRule/schema.yaml#/$defs/Target
    x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/target
  odrl:assigner:
    description: The party issuing the Offer, normally the repository or data custodian,
      given once at policy level (range odrl:Party). ODRL also accepts an assigner
      on every rule instead; CDIF asks for the policy-level form. The spreadsheet
      does not list an assigner yet.
    $ref: https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/metadataBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/bbr/metadata/odrlProperties/odrlRule/schema.yaml#/$defs/PartyRef
    x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/assigner
  odrl:assignee:
    description: Party all rules apply to, if given once at policy level (range odrl:Party).
    $ref: https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/metadataBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/bbr/metadata/odrlProperties/odrlRule/schema.yaml#/$defs/PartyRef
    x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/assignee
  odrl:permission:
    description: Actions a user may perform on the target (usage conditions).
    type: array
    minItems: 1
    items:
      type: object
      properties:
        odrl:target:
          description: The asset, normally a distribution or data service (range odrl:Asset).
          $ref: https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/metadataBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/bbr/metadata/odrlProperties/odrlRule/schema.yaml#/$defs/Target
          x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/target
        odrl:output:
          description: An asset created by exercising the action (range odrl:Asset).
          $ref: https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/metadataBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/bbr/metadata/odrlProperties/odrlRule/schema.yaml#/$defs/Target
          x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/output
        odrl:action:
          description: 'The permitted action (range odrl:Action). OPEN: the cdifa1
            action vocabulary is not defined, so values are not enumerated; whether
            it is an ODRL profile or a standalone controlled vocabulary is still to
            be settled.'
          $ref: https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/metadataBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/bbr/metadata/odrlProperties/odrlAction/schema.yaml
          x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/action
        odrl:assigner:
          description: Party granting this permission, if not given at policy level
            (range odrl:Party).
          $ref: https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/metadataBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/bbr/metadata/odrlProperties/odrlRule/schema.yaml#/$defs/PartyRef
          x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/assigner
        odrl:assignee:
          description: 'Who may exercise the permission (range odrl:Party), as a party
            or a (refined) PartyCollection, e.g. registered users located in the UK.
            This is the book''s form; the spreadsheet scopes users with odrl:constraint
            instead. OPEN: settle on one, or say when each is used.'
          $ref: https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/metadataBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/bbr/metadata/odrlProperties/odrlRule/schema.yaml#/$defs/PartyRef
          x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/assignee
        odrl:constraint:
          description: Conditions on exercising the permission (range odrl:Constraint),
            e.g. only users located in the UK (the spreadsheet's way of scoping users;
            see odrl:assignee).
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/metadataBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/bbr/metadata/odrlProperties/odrlConstraint/schema.yaml
          x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/constraint
        odrl:duty:
          description: 'Access conditions (range odrl:Duty): actions that must be
            completed before the permitted action, e.g. assent to an End User Licence
            before download.'
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/$defs/AccessCondition'
          x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/duty
      required:
      - odrl:target
      - odrl:action
    x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/permission
  odrl:obligation:
    description: 'Actions every user of the target must perform (range odrl:Duty),
      e.g. destroy the data at the end of a project. The spreadsheet gives 1..*; drafted
      as 0..* because an Offer with only permissions is common. OPEN: confirm.'
    type: array
    items:
      $ref: https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/metadataBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/bbr/metadata/odrlProperties/odrlRule/schema.yaml#/$defs/Duty
    x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/obligation
  odrl:prohibition:
    description: Actions a user must not perform (range odrl:Prohibition), e.g. share
      TRE credentials.
    type: array
    items:
      type: object
      properties:
        odrl:target:
          description: The asset (range odrl:Asset).
          $ref: https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/metadataBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/bbr/metadata/odrlProperties/odrlRule/schema.yaml#/$defs/Target
          x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/target
        odrl:output:
          description: An asset created by exercising the action (range odrl:Asset).
          $ref: https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/metadataBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/bbr/metadata/odrlProperties/odrlRule/schema.yaml#/$defs/Target
          x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/output
        odrl:action:
          description: The prohibited action (range odrl:Action).
          $ref: https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/metadataBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/bbr/metadata/odrlProperties/odrlAction/schema.yaml
          x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/action
        odrl:assigner:
          description: Party issuing this prohibition, if not given at policy level
            (range odrl:Party).
          $ref: https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/metadataBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/bbr/metadata/odrlProperties/odrlRule/schema.yaml#/$defs/PartyRef
          x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/assigner
        odrl:assignee:
          description: Who the prohibition applies to (range odrl:Party).
          $ref: https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/metadataBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/bbr/metadata/odrlProperties/odrlRule/schema.yaml#/$defs/PartyRef
          x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/assignee
        odrl:constraint:
          description: Conditions under which the prohibition applies (range odrl:Constraint).
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/metadataBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/bbr/metadata/odrlProperties/odrlConstraint/schema.yaml
          x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/constraint
        odrl:remedy:
          description: Duties owed if the prohibition is infringed (range odrl:Duty).
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/metadataBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/bbr/metadata/odrlProperties/odrlRule/schema.yaml#/$defs/Duty
          x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/remedy
      required:
      - odrl:target
      - odrl:action
    x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/prohibition
required:
- '@type'
- '@id'
- odrl:profile
- odrl:assigner
- odrl:permission
$defs:
  accessConditionMarker:
    description: 'The constraint odrl:event odrl:lt odrl:policyUsage: the duty must
      be fulfilled before the permission is exercised. In CDIF Access this is what
      marks a duty as an access condition. Each operand accepts the odrl: compact
      IRI and the full IRI.'
    type: object
    properties:
      odrl:leftOperand:
        type: object
        properties:
          '@id':
            enum:
            - odrl:event
            - http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/event
        required:
        - '@id'
        x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/leftOperand
      odrl:operator:
        type: object
        properties:
          '@id':
            enum:
            - odrl:lt
            - http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/lt
        required:
        - '@id'
        x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/operator
      odrl:rightOperand:
        type: object
        properties:
          '@id':
            enum:
            - odrl:policyUsage
            - http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/policyUsage
        required:
        - '@id'
        x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/rightOperand
    required:
    - odrl:leftOperand
    - odrl:operator
    - odrl:rightOperand
  AccessCondition:
    description: 'A permission duty carrying the accessConditionMarker. The spreadsheet
      gives the duty action as 1..*; ODRL allows one action per rule, so several pre-conditions
      are several duties. OPEN: the spreadsheet does not say what an assent duty assents
      to (e.g. which licence document); a duty target is one candidate. OPEN: the
      spreadsheet lists constraint @type with cardinality 1 but gives no value and
      omits it on this constraint, so it is optional.'
    type: object
    properties:
      odrl:action:
        description: The action to complete first, e.g. cdifa1:assent (range odrl:Action).
        $ref: https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/metadataBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/bbr/metadata/odrlProperties/odrlAction/schema.yaml
        x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/action
      odrl:constraint:
        description: Must include the accessConditionMarker (range odrl:Constraint).
        type: array
        items:
          $ref: https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/metadataBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/bbr/metadata/odrlProperties/odrlConstraint/schema.yaml
        contains:
          $ref: '#/$defs/accessConditionMarker'
        x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/constraint
    required:
    - odrl:action
    - odrl:constraint
x-jsonld-prefixes:
  odrl: http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/
  cdifa1: https://w3id.org/cdif/access/profile1/
  rdf: http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#
  xsd: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#
x-bblocks-metadata:
  itemIdentifier: cdif.bbr.metadata.odrlProperties.odrlOffer
  register: https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/metadataBuildingBlocks/build/register.json
  version: '0.1'
  dateOfLastChange: '2026-10-28'
